purpose: Teach: 下る/改める/件名/にせよ/借家/召集/所蔵/年頃

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の決算、本気で、絶対、悪く、下る方向、避けろ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、社員、皆、本当に、絶対、本気、絶対だ。
lines.en: This quarter's results — I need them to move in the right direction, not down. I'm serious. Everyone needs to be on the same page here.
lines.style: Controlled intensity. Measured cadence with weight on key words. Slight pause between directives. No emotion, but unmistakable pressure underneath. The voice of someone who expects to be heard the first time.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内方針、本気で、改めるべきところ、絶対、見直してまいります、本気で、感謝、しております、本当に、絶対、本気。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We'll review our internal policies thoroughly and make the necessary improvements. Thank you for your guidance — we take this very seriously.
lines.style: Formal, respectful, measured. Clear enunciation. Steady pace without rushing. The slight rasp of someone swallowing before speaking. Genuine in the gratitude but grounded — not obsequious.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: メール、本気で、件名、絶対、わかりやすく、書け、本気で、社員、徹底させろ、本気で、絶対、頼んだぞ、絶対、本気で。
lines.en: And on emails — make sure the subject lines are clear and specific. Have everyone stick to that standard without exception.
lines.style: Clipped, direct. Emphasis on the practical detail. No preamble. The tone of someone giving instructions that will be written down and followed. Slight hardening of the consonants.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。来期の業績、悪化するにせよ、本気で、社員、絶対、守ってまいります、本気で、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Understood. Even if next quarter's numbers decline, we'll do everything in our power to protect this team. That's our commitment.
lines.style: Firm resolve beneath the formality. Slower tempo. The words matter individually here — not rushed through. A small hitch before 'protect,' like he means it personally, not just corporately.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業時の借家、本気で、社史に、絶対、残しておけ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、これは、本気で、本当に、絶対、頼む、絶対。
lines.en: The original documents from when we founded this company — keep them safe. Preserve them. That's important to me, and I mean that.
lines.style: Drops the corporate register slightly. More personal. Quieter than before but with clear weight. A slight tremor on 'keep them safe' — this is not just business. Steady eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、本気で、緊急召集、絶対、できる体制、整えております、本気で、危機管理、本当に、感謝、絶対、本気、絶対。
lines.en: Yes, sir. I'm setting up emergency procedures so we can mobilize the team quickly if needed. We're prepared for any crisis that comes.
lines.style: Crisp, capable. Demonstrating competence through precision. Faster pace than before but still controlled. The confidence of someone who has thought this through. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 創業時の資料、本気で、絶対、社内、所蔵、貴重な財産だ、絶対、本気で、社員、皆、誇りに、思え、絶対、本気で、本当に。
lines.en: The founding documents are valuable to this company's history. Everyone should understand that — they're part of who we are, and we should be proud of that.
lines.style: Shifts to a quieter, more reflective tone. Slower. The voice of someone making a small speech about legacy, not giving an order. Slight wistfulness underneath the firmness. Breathing room between phrases.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新人、本気で、結婚適齢期の年頃、絶対、いますね、社員、ライフ、本気で、応援してまいります、本気で、本当に、絶対。
lines.en: Yes, sir. And on a personal note — many of the newer staff are at the age where they're thinking about marriage and families. We want to support them through that too.
lines.style: Warmer than before. A small smile in the voice. Still respectful but more human now. Gentle pace. The undertone of someone who's noticed his boss cares about his people, not just the numbers.
